title: Stonetop Steading Improvement (third-party content)
description: Frontmatter contract for a steading improvement. Maps to Sled Dog's SteadingImprovementDef.

slug.description: kebab-case, no leading 'the-'. Sled Dog namespaces it (e.g. ppg:<slug>).

summary.description: One-line pitch shown in the picker.

requirements.description: Requirement lines the party checks off as they fulfill them.

requireCount.description: null = all required to acquire; a number = any N of the listed.

effects.description: What acquiring it does and its henceforth/upkeep rules, as prose.

impacts.description: Resource tracks the effect impacts (colored labels + filters). May be empty (e.g. an improvement that only grants a move).

seasons.description: Minimum seasons to complete (best-guess from the requirement text). Omit or null when the rules state none.

grants_moves.description: Home Front moves granted to every party character when the GM marks it acquired.
